title: Groups to stage Calabarzon-wide rallies on martial law anniversary

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Multisectoral organizations led by Bagong Alyansang Makabayan Southern Tagalog (BAYAN ST) will hold simultaneous protest actions across the Southern Tagalog region on Sept. 21 to mark the 54th anniversary of the declaration of Martial Law. Dubbed “Bahain ng Protesta ang Timog Katagalugan!”, the coordinated actions will be held at government offices and other key sites across Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Rizal and Quezon (Calabarzon), with organizers also citing concerns affecting communities in Mindoro.
